entries.60a79120a6d7bc0e: A fiber made almost entirely of carbon, produced by turning acrylic resin or pitch (a substance obtained from petroleum or coal) into fibers and applying a special heat treatment.
entries.bef8db92cefc25cb: A fiber made almost entirely of carbon, produced by turning acrylic resin or pitch (a substance obtained from petroleum or coal) into fibers and applying a special heat treatment. It is light and strong, and is used for a variety of purposes, usually as a composite material combined with resin or the like.
